data.description: Tranquil lifestyle with impressive investment opportunities, Sobha Reserve Dubai is Dubailand’s exquisite abode.

data.answer:
Sobha Reserve is a luxury gated community in the iconic city of Dubai developed by Sobha Realty. Nestled within expansive greenery and lush landscapes, this prestigious development offers a harmonious blend of sophistication and serenity. Boasting meticulously crafted villas and townhouses in Dubai, Sobha Reserve Community provides residents with spacious and elegant living spaces designed to elevate every aspect of modern living.

The community features world-class amenities, including parks, playgrounds, sports facilities, and leisure spaces, catering to its residents' diverse needs.

The spacious homes in the Sobha Reserve floor plan come in 4- and 5-bedroom configurations. The sizes of the villas start from 4900 sq. ft. 4-bedroom Sobha Reserve villas will have covered areas ranging between 4,983 sq. ft. to 4,998 sq. ft. These properties will be available in Type A, Type B, and Type C options. The G+1 villas have a private garden, swimming pool, an open terrace area, a walk-in wardrobe, and spacious living spaces overlooking the pool area and garden.

5-bedroom Sobha Reserve villas span from 5,684 sq. ft. to 5,747 sq. ft. Available as Type A, Type B, Type C, and Type D, the G+1 units will have a private swimming pool, a private garden, and an open terrace area overlooking the pool.  Sobha Reserve Villas in Dubai comes with a range of high-end amenities for a luxury living experience. These include private swimming pools, a fully equipped gym, a community clubhouse, landscaped gardens, and kids' play areas. Residents will also get access to spa and sauna facilities within the community.

Properties for Sale in Sobha Reserve

There are various villas available for sale in Sobha Reserve. The price for 4-bedroom villas available in Sobha Reserve starts from AED 7.7M. As for 5-bedroom villas within Sobha Reserve, prospective buyers can expect prices starting from AED 8.77M.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Dubai Sobha Reserve?

data.answer:
Life in the upcoming Dubai Sobha Reserve promises to be a harmonious blend of luxury, tranquillity, and convenience. Situated amidst lush greenery and landscaped gardens, Sobha Reserve offers residents a serene retreat from bustling city life while still being close to urban amenities and attractions.

Public Transportation near Sobha Reserve Dubailand

The area is not connected to public transportation right now. The nearest bus stop is Arabian Ranches, Al Reem 3. From there you can take an RTA taxi or car-hailing service to reach the destination.

Parking Facilities

The Sustainable City offers well-designed parking facilities to accommodate both residents and visitors. The community provides ample parking spaces, including dedicated spots for electric vehicles and car-sharing programs to promote sustainable transportation. These facilities are strategically located to ensure easy access while maintaining the pedestrian-friendly nature of the community. Underground and shaded parking areas help protect vehicles from the harsh climate, ensuring convenience and comfort for all users.

Supermarkets near Sobha Reserve

Once completed, the Sobha Reserve Dubai community will have a self-service shop offering a wide variety of food & household products. Moreover, within a 15-minute drive, you can find Zoom. A convenience store chain in Dubai, Zoom is popular for grabbing snacks, drinks, groceries, and other convenience items on the go.

Shopping in Sobha Reserve

Around 17 minutes from the area is Dubai Mall, the Emirates’ most popular retail, leisure, and dining destination. The nearby Meadows Village Shopping Centre, situated within the Meadows community in Dubai, is a well-loved retail hub frequented by residents. Here, residents enjoy a hassle-free shopping experience complemented by amenities and services. The center boasts a diverse selection of retail stores, encompassing supermarkets.

The upcoming Cityland Mall in Global Village is located 9 minutes away from the area. Once completed, it will be one of the most convenient retail destinations near Sobha Reserve.

Schools Near Sobha Reserve

Within a 1 km radius of the Sobha Reserve location, GEM Winchester School is located. The school follows the British curriculum and provides an outstanding early-year, primary, and secondary education to children from the Foundation Stage to Year 13.

Clinics and Hospitals in Sobha Reserve Dubai

Nad Al Sheba Health Center is 12 minutes away from Sobha Reserve, Medcare Hospital is 18 minutes away, and Latifa Hospital is around 20 minutes driving distance from Sobha Reserve location. Each of these centers offers a range of medical services and expertise to meet the healthcare needs of residents, ensuring timely and accessible healthcare support when required.

Sobha Reserve Location & Nearby Areas

Some of the nearby areas within the Sobha Reserve location include Falcon City of Wonders, the City of Arabia, The Villa, Villa Nova, and Majan. You can also access Dubai International Airport, Dubai Creek Harbour, and Business Bay within a 20-minute drive.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Sobha Reserve

data.answer:
With its tranquil surroundings and range of amenities, Sobha Reserve provides residents with ample opportunities to lead an active and fulfilling lifestyle.

Restaurants Near Sobha Reserve Dubai

There will be several cafes, restaurants, and dining options within Sobha Reserve after the completion. Also, there are restaurants near the community. Located approximately 10 minutes away, Cafe Isan offers authentic Thai cuisine in a cozy and welcoming atmosphere. Situated around 15 minutes away, Jones the Grocer is a popular spot known for its gourmet food, delicious coffee, and relaxed dining ambiance.

About 20 minutes away from Sobha Reserve, Zafran Indian Bistro serves up delectable Indian cuisine with a modern twist, perfect for those craving flavorful dishes in a sophisticated setting. Roughly a 25-minute drive from Sobha Reserve, Shakespeare and Co. is a charming cafe known for its extensive menu featuring international dishes, decadent desserts, and delightful afternoon tea options.

Beaches Near Sobha Reserve

Currently, there is no beach near the area. The nearest option is JBR Beach, which is about 25 minutes away from Sobha Reserve, Dubailand.

Hotels near the Sobha Reserve Dubai Area

Located approximately 15 minutes away from Sobha Reserve, Marriott Al Jaddaf offers travelers luxurious accommodations and excellent amenities. Situated around 20 minutes from Sobha Reserve, Rove Healthcare City provides stylish and affordable accommodation options for business and leisure travelers.

Attractions and Landmarks Near Sobha Reserve Dubailand

Located within the City of Arabia, IMG Worlds of Adventure is just 3 minutes away from the community. The city’s largest indoor theme and amusement park, IMG boasts five epic zones, including Marvel, Cartoon Network, and others.

Within a 15-minute drive from the community is Global Village and Wadi Degla Sports Club. Global Village is a vibrant cultural and entertainment destination representing the world's diverse cultures via pavilions of different countries. Visitors can explore unique retail experiences, enjoy diverse cuisines, try thrilling rides, and watch live entertainment shows.

On the other hand, Wadi Degla Sports Club provides state-of-the-art facilities for sports enthusiasts. From swimming pools and fitness centers to tennis courts and football fields, the club offers a wide range of activities for individuals and families alike. With professional coaching and various sports programs, Wadi Degla Sports Club promotes a healthy and active lifestyle within a welcoming community atmosphere.

Community Events and Social Life

The Sustainable City fosters a vibrant social life through a variety of community events and activities that bring residents together. Regularly organized events such as farmers' markets, eco-workshops, fitness classes, and cultural festivals create a strong sense of community and engagement. The community centers, parks, and shared spaces provide ideal venues for social interactions, allowing residents to connect, collaborate, and build lasting relationships. This focus on social sustainability enhances the overall living experience, making The Sustainable City not just a place to live, but a thriving community.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Sobha Reserve presents a plethora of outdoor activities tailored to suit diverse interests and preferences. Residents can indulge in invigorating cycling and jogging sessions along tree-lined pathways or enjoy leisurely picnics and barbecues in the community parks. For For those seeking aquatic relaxation, private swimming pools in many villas offer a perfect retreat.

Outdoor sports enthusiasts can engage in friendly matches of tennis, basketball, or football, while nature lovers can immerse themselves in serene nature walks amidst lush greenery. Families with children can make use of the well-equipped playgrounds and play areas, ensuring endless hours of fun and exploration. With its array of outdoor amenities, Sobha Reserve fosters an active and vibrant lifestyle, promoting wellness and enjoyment for all its residents. There will be a fully-equipped gym, salon, and spa in the community as well.

Although Sobha Reserve is an excellent community to call your future home, there are a few things you need to consider before investing. As Sobha Reserve is still developing, residents can experience construction-related noise and dust. Also, note that there is limited access to public transportation options.

What is the Sobha Reserve completion date?

Sobha Reserve handover is expected to be in 2026.

Who is the owner of Sobha Reserve?

Master developer Sobha Realty has developed the Sobha Reserve project.

What is the Sobha Reserve area price?

The properties in the area start from AED 7.7M.

Is there public transportation available near Sobha Reserve?

While Sobha Reserve may have access to public transportation options such as buses and taxis, residents may primarily rely on private vehicles for commuting and getting around.

What are the nearby shopping and dining options?

Nearby shopping and dining options include City Centre Me'aisem, Mall of the Emirates, and Dubai Marina Mall, offering a wide range of retail outlets, restaurants, cafes, and entertainment venues.

data.content:
Adorned with tree-lined walkways and flower-patterned clusters, Sobha Reserve at Wadi Al Safa 2, Dubailand, is a tranquil community. It is an under-development district in the larger Dubailand area. The 3.47 million sq. ft. area features a clubhouse, sports court, and swimming pool.

Sobha Reserve master plan includes villas with beautifully crafted interiors and impressive architectural details. The upscale residences within the freehold enclave present an enticing investment opportunity for individuals seeking property ownership in one of the world's most dynamic cities.

The Sobha Reserve location close to Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street makes it easy for residents to commute in and out of the community. The luxury green project is expected to be completed by 2026.
